# Megam.io

> Closure record of Megam Systems LLP and Rio/OS — an open-source cloud
> management platform (CMP) and platform-as-a-service (PaaS) built from
> Chennai, India between 2012 and 2018, and the Rio/OS private-cloud
> operating-system phase that followed before the October 2018 pivot to
> Lendsmart / Getattune.

Entity: Megam Systems LLP (registered March 2013, Chennai, India).
Founder: Kishorekumar Neelamegam.
Status: Active product development ended October 2018. Open-source code remains public.
Acquirer: Rio Advancement Inc. (Paul Sanar).
Successor projects: Lendsmart, Getattune.
Contact: nkishore@megam.io

## Site map

- [Home](https://megam.io/): one-paragraph summary and entry points.
- [Timeline](https://megam.io/timeline): dated phases — Megam (Jul 2012–Jul 2017), Rio/OS (Jul 2017–Oct 2018), Pivot (Oct 2018 onward).
- [Architecture](https://megam.io/architecture): Megam v1 (Nilavu UI, Vertice Gateway API, Vertice scheduler, Gulp lifecycle agent) and Rio/OS Rust-era components.
- [Products](https://megam.io/products): Vertice, Cloud-in-a-Box, Nilavu, Rio/OS, and the named Phase 1 customer accounts.
- [Team](https://megam.io/team): the small Chennai team and downstream successor projects.
- [Why it did not work](https://megam.io/why-it-didnt-work): sourced failure analysis across market, product, architecture, distribution, capital, org, timing, pivot.
- [Artifacts](https://megam.io/artifacts): public repositories (github.com/megamsys, github.com/rioos2), docs, talks, videos, archive folders.
- [Lessons](https://megam.io/lessons): durable takeaways.
- [Colophon](https://megam.io/colophon): build, source, license, corrections.
